title: International Building Code 2021
disclaimer: An encoded subset of the IBC, covering egress geometry and occupant load only. The IBC has no force until a jurisdiction adopts it, and adopting jurisdictions amend it. Structural, fire-resistance, energy and accessibility provisions are not encoded here at all.

parameters.$comment: IBC Table 1004.5, converted from square feet per occupant to square metres.

rules.title: Egress door clear width
rules.message: A doorway serving {serves} gives {clear_width_mm} mm clear; §1010.1.1 requires 813 mm (32 in).
rules.note: The clear width is measured with the door open 90 degrees, between the face of the door and the stop.

rules.title: Corridor width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm wide serving {occupants} occupants; §1020.3 requires 1118 mm at 50 occupants or more, 914 mm below that.

rules.title: Minimum ceiling height
rules.message: {name} has about {clear_height_mm} mm clear; §1003.2 requires 2286 mm (7 ft 6 in) over occupiable space.

rules.title: Stair riser height
rules.message: The riser is {riser_mm} mm; §1011.5.2 caps it at 178 mm (7 in).

rules.title: Stair tread depth
rules.message: The tread is {going_mm} mm deep; §1011.5.2 requires 279 mm (11 in).

rules.title: Stairway width
rules.message: The stair is {width_mm} mm wide; §1011.2 requires 1118 mm (44 in) where the occupant load served is 50 or more.
rules.note: Reduces to 914 mm (36 in) where the occupant load served is under 50.

rules.title: Stairway headroom
rules.message: Headroom is {headroom_mm} mm; §1011.3 requires 2032 mm (80 in).

rules.title: Exit access travel distance
rules.message: Travel from {name} is about {travel_distance_mm} mm; §1017.2 allows 60960 mm (200 ft) without sprinklers.
rules.note: Rises to 91440 mm (300 ft) in a sprinklered building for most occupancies. Measured here through the door graph.

rules.title: Number of exits per storey
rules.message: {name} serves {occupants} occupants with {exit_count} exit(s); §1006.3.2 requires two above 49.
